items.summary: Schedule axis explored; constant beat linear-decay by ~+1pp (Phase N 0.368 vs Phase L 0.356) but signal-set is the binding constraint. Next move: signal-mix change (drop weak signals; add value-head-delta tempo signal per scoping notes option (1)).

Implementation blocked: value-head output is not in trace schema; rollout emits placeholder value_pred=0.0 (ppo_orchestrator.py:858), PPO recomputes value at training-time. Adding the signal requires TS-side ONNX call-site instrumentation in backend/src/sim/, schema extension on behaviorPolicy or top-level trace field, and ONNX export verification that the value head is a named output of rollout.onnx / policy.gate.onnx. Separate sprint-slot work — see r15-s3-value-head-trace-instrumentation.

Sim-side prerequisite for Phase O value-head tempo signal. (1) Audit rollout.onnx / policy.gate.onnx output signature for a named value head; if missing, extend the export step. (2) Update the TS-side ONNX inference call site (search backend/src/sim/ for the policy-server client) to capture the value scalar per request. (3) Extend the decision-trace schema (likely `behaviorPolicy.valueEstimate: number` or top-level `valuePred`) and update relabelDecisionTrace.ts to forward it. (4) Regenerate a smoke trace; verify the new field is present. Then unblock r15-s3-value-head-tempo-signal.

items.summary: Phase O' — drop the 2 weakest of the 5 reward shaping signals, scale the strongest 2-3 to ~1.5x. Tests whether signal-MIX composition has further headroom independent of signal-SET. Same constant schedule, same warm-start, same HPs. If iter-2 >= 0.40 -> signal-mix unlocks F1 success. If iter-2 ~= 0.37 -> signal-set is genuinely binding; pivot to value-head instrumentation or R7/R8. Coefs: active-energy 0.03 (was 0.02 x1.5), bench-energy 0.0 (dropped - 2nd weakest non-zero), retreat 0.0 (dropped - zero contribution per Phase N attribution), throughput 0.03 (was 0.02 x1.5 - largest contributor), hp-diff 0.05 (held - anti-correlated per attribution, kept as control). Per-game budget ~0.24, close to Phase M's 0.23.
